name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Central sector scheme providing income support to all landholding farmer families across the country to supplement their financial needs for agricultural inputs and domestic requirements.
benefits: Direct income benefit of ₹6,000 per year transferred in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly into the bank accounts of eligible farmer families.

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be an agricultural cultivator/farmer
Applicant must hold verified farmer status

application_information: Apply online at the official PM-KISAN Portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or visit nearest Common Service Center (CSC) / District Agriculture Office.
source_name: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
description: Old age pension scheme for small and marginal farmers providing social security when they reach 60 years of age.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹3,000 upon reaching 60 years of age.

eligibility_rules.description: Must be a small or marginal farmer
Entry age must be at least 18 years
Entry age must not exceed 40 years

required_documents: Savings Bank Account / Jan Dhan Account with IFSC
Copy of land revenue record / Patta
application_information: Enroll through Village Level Entrepreneurs (VLEs) at any Common Service Center (CSC) or online on the Maandhan portal.
source_name: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare & LIC

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin
description: Social welfare programme providing pucca houses with basic amenities to all houseless households and those living in kutcha and dilapidated houses in rural areas.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult areas along with 90/95 days of unskilled labor wages under MGNREGA.

eligibility_rules.description: Beneficiary must reside in a rural area
Annual household income must be within economically weaker parameters (<= ₹3,00,000)

required_documents: Aadhaar Number of all family members
application_information: Beneficiaries are identified using SECC list validated by Gram Sabha. Registration assisted via Gram Panchayat or Awaas+ portal.
source_name: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban
description: Mission addressing urban housing shortage among EWS/LIG and MIG categories by ensuring a pucca house to eligible urban households.
benefits: Interest subsidy up to 6.5% on housing loans or direct central assistance of ₹1.5 lakh for new construction/enhancement.

eligibility_rules.description: Beneficiary family must reside in a statutory urban town
Annual household income must not exceed ₹6,000,000 for EWS/LIG housing subsidy

required_documents: Affidavit confirming no pucca house owned across India
application_information: Apply online at pmaymis.gov.in or visit designated Common Service Centers (CSCs) or Urban Local Body office.
source_name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
description: Flagship scheme providing clean cooking LPG connections to women from economically disadvantaged families without upfront security deposit.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection, first refill and hotplate (stove) provided free of cost, plus ongoing targeted subsidy per cylinder.

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be an adult woman of the household
Applicant must be at least 18 years old
Household income should fall under low-income criteria (<= ₹2,50,000)

required_documents: Aadhaar card of applicant and adult family members
Ration Card or BPL certificate proving household composition
Bank Account details (Jan Dhan or Savings)
application_information: Submit application directly at any authorized LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, HP Gas) or apply online at pmuy.gov.in.
source_name: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Government of India

name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: National pension scheme targeted primarily at the unorganized sector workers to provide self-funded retirement security.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 starting from the age of 60 based on contribution.

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be at least 18 years of age at joining
Applicant must not exceed 40 years of age at joining

required_documents: Savings Bank Account / Post Office Account
application_information: Enroll through any public or private sector commercial bank or post office where you hold a savings account.
source_name: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
description: Non-contributory social security pension for senior citizens living below the poverty line.
benefits: Monthly central pension of ₹200 to ₹500 (often supplemented to ₹1,000-₹2,500 by state government top-ups).

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be a senior citizen aged 60 years or above
Must belong to Below Poverty Line (BPL) or low-income threshold

required_documents: Age proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Birth Certificate)
BPL Card or Income Certificate from Tehsildar
application_information: Submit application form at the office of Block Development Officer (BDO) in rural areas or Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) / Municipal Corporation in urban areas.
source_name: Ministry of Rural Development (NSAP Portal)

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
description: Micro-credit facility providing affordable collateral-free working capital loans to urban street vendors to resume livelihoods.
benefits: Initial working capital loan up to ₹10,000, enhanced to ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 on timely repayment, with 7% interest subsidy.

eligibility_rules.description: Must be engaged in vending or hawking goods/services
Vending activity must be situated in urban or peri-urban locations

required_documents: Certificate of Vending / ID Card issued by Urban Local Body (ULB)
application_information: Apply via PM SVANidhi portal (pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in) or mobile app, or via local Banking Correspondents / Common Service Centers.
source_name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
description: Provides collateral-free institutional loans up to ₹10 lakh to micro and small non-corporate, non-farm enterprises.
benefits: Collateral-free loans in three categories: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishor (₹50,000 to ₹5 lakh), and Tarun (₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh).

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be an adult citizen of at least 18 years
Applicant must be seeking self-employment or running a micro-enterprise

required_documents: Quotation of machinery/items to be purchased
application_information: Apply online at Udyamimitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or at any public/private commercial bank, RRB, or MFI.
source_name: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance

name: Centrally Sponsored Post Matric Scholarship Scheme
description: Financial assistance to students pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary courses to enable them to complete higher education.
benefits: Full compulsory non-refundable fees reimbursement plus maintenance allowance up to ₹13,500 per year depending on course category.

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be currently enrolled in post-matric studies
Total family annual income must not exceed ₹2,50,000

required_documents: Caste Certificate (if applicable for reserved schemes)
Income Certificate issued by designated state authority
Fee receipt and Mark sheet of qualifying examination
Bank Account details in student's name
application_information: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) during the open application window.
source_name: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / Ministry of Tribal Affairs

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Small deposit savings scheme backed by Government of India exclusively for the welfare and higher education of the girl child.
benefits: High compound interest rate (currently 8.2% p.a.), tax exemptions under Section 80C, and maturity benefit on child turning 21.

eligibility_rules.description: Beneficiary must be a girl child
Account must be opened before girl child attains 10 years of age

application_information: Open an account at any Post Office branch or designated authorized commercial bank branch.
source_name: National Savings Institute / Ministry of Finance

name: Punjab Crop Loan Waiver Scheme (State Welfare)
description: State debt alleviation initiative providing crop loan waiver for small and marginal farmers with landholdings in the State of Punjab.
benefits: Waiver of outstanding crop loans up to ₹2,00,000 taken from cooperative and commercial banks.

eligibility_rules.description: Must be a permanent resident farmer of Punjab
Must be an active agricultural cultivator

required_documents: Cooperative Bank / Commercial Bank Kisan Credit Card loan passbook
application_information: Verified by District Administration committees through respective Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS).
source_name: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of Punjab

name: Punjab Financial Assistance to Elderly Citizens (Old Age Pension)
description: Monthly social security financial assistance provided by the Department of Social Security of Punjab to elderly senior citizens who lack sufficient livelihood sources.
benefits: Direct benefit transfer of ₹1,500 per month credited directly into beneficiary bank account.

eligibility_rules.description: Must be a bona fide resident of Punjab
Applicant age must be at least 60 years
Annual family income must not exceed ₹60,000

required_documents: Age Proof (Voter Card / Matriculation Certificate / Birth Certificate)
Family Income Certificate issued by Tehsildar
application_information: Submit application form at Sewa Kendra or online via Connect Punjab portal (connect.punjab.gov.in).
source_name: Department of Social Security and Women & Child Development, Government of Punjab

name: Punjab Financial Assistance to Widows and Destitute Women
description: Social security pension for widows, destitute, and abandoned women residing in Punjab who lack independent financial livelihood.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,500 deposited directly into beneficiary bank account.

eligibility_rules.description: Must be a bona fide resident of Punjab
Applicant must be female
Annual family income must not exceed ₹60,000

required_documents: Death Certificate of Husband or Certificate of Destitution
application_information: Apply online at Sewa Kendras or through the District Social Security Officer (DSSO).
source_name: Department of Social Security, Government of Punjab

name: Punjab Financial Assistance to Disabled Persons (Divyang Pension)
description: Monthly state pension support for persons with disabilities (Divyangjan) residing in the State of Punjab.
benefits: Monthly financial grant of ₹1,500 per month.

eligibility_rules.description: Must be a bona fide resident of Punjab
Must possess certified disability (minimum 40%)
Annual family income must not exceed ₹60,000

application_information: Submit application via nearest Sewa Kendra or online on Connect Punjab portal.
source_name: Department of Social Security, Government of Punjab

name: Punjab Ashirwad Scheme (Shagun Financial Assistance for Marriage)
description: State financial assistance grant provided for the solemnization of marriage of daughters belonging to Scheduled Castes, Backward Classes, and Economically Weaker Sections in Punjab.
benefits: Direct one-time financial assistance of ₹51,000 transferred into the bank account of the girl or her mother.

eligibility_rules.description: Must be a permanent resident of Punjab
Beneficiary must be a girl / bride
Bride age must be at least 18 years
Family annual income must not exceed ₹32,790

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of Bride and Parents
Proof of Age (Matriculation Certificate / Birth Certificate)
Wedding Card or Marriage Registration Certificate
application_information: Apply online at Ashirwad Portal (ashirwad.punjab.gov.in) or submit at Citizen Sewa Kendra at least 30 days prior to or within 30 days after marriage.
source_name: Department of Social Justice, Empowerment and Minorities, Government of Punjab

name: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Post Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students
description: Punjab state scholarship covering full institutional fee and monthly allowance for Scheduled Caste students pursuing post-matriculation or higher education in recognized institutions.
benefits: 100% reimbursement of tuition fees, non-refundable college fees, and monthly maintenance allowance.

eligibility_rules.description: Must be a bona fide resident of Punjab
Must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) category
Must be actively enrolled as a post-matric student
Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000

required_documents: Family Income Certificate issued by Tehsildar
application_information: Apply on the Dr. Ambedkar Punjab State Scholarship Portal (scholarships.punjab.gov.in).
source_name: Department of Social Justice, Empowerment and Minorities, Punjab

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: National crop insurance flagship scheme supporting sustainable agriculture by providing comprehensive financial insurance support against crop failure due to natural calamities, pests, and unseasonal weather.
benefits: Comprehensive insurance claim coverage for non-preventable risks: localized calamities, standing crop yield loss, and post-harvest losses with heavily subsidized premium (1.5% for Rabi, 2% for Kharif).

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be an active cultivator/farmer
Applicant must have verified farmer standing

application_information: Enroll via National Crop Insurance Portal (pmfby.gov.in), authorized banks, or Common Service Centers (CSCs).
source_name: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Maternity benefit cash transfer scheme providing partial wage compensation to pregnant women and lactating mothers for health checkups, nutrition, and institutional delivery.
benefits: Direct cash incentive of ₹5,000 paid in installments upon registration of pregnancy, antenatal check-up, and institutional childbirth.

eligibility_rules.description: Beneficiary must be a female / mother
Mother age must be at least 19 years at pregnancy

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of beneficiary and spouse
application_information: Register at the nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or approved health facility, or apply online on pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.
source_name: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India

name: Punjab Shehri Awas Yojana (PSAY - Affordable Urban Housing)
description: State housing initiative providing financial grant and subsidized pucca dwelling units for homeless, slum-dwellers, and economically weaker section (EWS) urban households across municipal areas of Punjab.
benefits: Capital grant of ₹1,50,000 for individual house construction / enhancement for eligible urban EWS families.

eligibility_rules.description: Must be a bona fide resident of Punjab
Must reside in an urban / municipal area
Annual family income must not exceed ₹3,00,000

required_documents: Land / Plot title deed or Municipal NOC
application_information: Apply through municipal corporations/councils or online on Punjab Urban Planning & Development Authority (PUDA) housing portal.
source_name: Department of Housing and Urban Development, Government of Punjab
